in_sanskrit.name: Sujay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rule, Govern
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sujay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sujay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sujaya’, meaning ‘one who rules or governs’. This name is associated with power, leadership, and authority.

in_marathi.name: Sujay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sujay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sujay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sujaya’, meaning ‘one who rules or governs’. This name is associated with power, leadership, and authority.
